about: Questions for Ask the Archive, with what a correct answer must contain. Used by tests/verify-archive.js (quick answers, in Node) and tests/archive-eval.html (quick and written answers, in a browser). 'all': every string must appear in the answer; 'any': at least one; 'none': no match for these regular expressions; 'insufficient': the right answer is to say the records cannot answer, or to ask which person is meant; 'people': the question must be read as being about these people; 'after': earlier questions in the same conversation. Questions with 'round': 2, 3 or 4 were written in later rounds, run once without tuning, and then fixed; the evaluation report in docs/ask-the-archive.md gives the first-run result for each round. 'firstRun' records how the answer was judged by hand the first time the question was asked: right, partly or wrong.
